name: Invoice Totals 7
definition: Specifies totals related to the invoice.

Adjustment.name: Adjustment
Adjustment.definition: Variance on invoice amount taking into account discounts, allowances and charges.

TotalInvoiceAmount.name: Total Invoice Amount
TotalInvoiceAmount.definition: Total amount of the invoice, being the sum of total invoice lines amounts, total invoice adjustment amount (discounts, allowances and charges) and total tax amounts.

PaymentDueDate.name: Payment Due Date
PaymentDueDate.definition: Due date for the payment of the invoice.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Cash account from which the fees are paid.
